acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: Crawljax https://github.com/crawljax/crawljax , Firebase Robo https://firebase.google.com/docs/test-lab/android/robo-ux-test .

Gap: nothing discovers routes that the static dialects miss.

Proposal: an operator-run, GET-only, link-only crawl of an owned local fixture under NEX-V0 limits and effect classes. URLs it reaches that match no mapped route are reported as unmapped evidence with no authority. AI or hosted exploration (Octomind, QA Wolf) is out of scope. Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: appmap: bounded local link-only discovery crawl reporting unmapped URLs
